aura: Distinct two scaled finned legs/goat feet c02 and active shoreline emergence c03 create benevolent awe, no aura.
artistic_choices: Benevolent grave gaze, weathered adult face and practical opaque high-neck long-sleeved top; no glamour makeup or sexualized pose.
Large ragged fins and irregular thick body scales emphasize documented anatomy c02 at thumbnail size; two cloven goat hooves enlarged by close perspective, not giant scale.

Breaking waves are ordinary sea conditions around her emergence c03, not controlled or generated by her. No kelp is added because it is not in the claims. Moonlit dark basalt coast is editorial context.
prompt: ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Mulher Marinha, a benevolent Portuguese sea daughter emerging from the Atlantic. ANATOMY: ONE fully ADULT woman, ONE head, two natural eyes, TWO human arms, one torso fully dressed in plain OPAQUE HIGH-NECK LONG-SLEEVED dark sea-green top. From WAIST DOWN her own body is covered in IRREGULAR THICK OVERLAPPING SILVER-GREEN FISH SCALES, raised and rough, organic flesh scales not leggings, not scale-print costume. Exactly TWO SEPARATE LEGS ending in TWO LARGE CLOVEN GOAT HOOVES, each hoof with two dark horn halves and a deep central split. Large RAGGED TRANSLUCENT FINS run along the OUTER side of each leg, from thigh to calf; both fins conspicuous as broad jagged fans projecting outward. No fish tail, horns, wings, extra limbs or jewelry [mulher-marinha-c01,c02]. MOMENT: RISE FROM THE SEA itself and plant two goat hooves powerfully on low black basalt before the viewer. A natural breaking WAVE towers immediately behind and above her shoulders, its white water pouring from hair, top and scales. One hand opens palm forward in grave benevolent greeting, other extended low to steady herself, five fingers on each hand. Face is GRAVE AND OTHERWORLDLY, mature weathered features with salt and water, severe cheekbones, shut mouth, steady direct EYE CONTACT WITH VIEWER. No makeup, glamour smile, dreamy look, parted-lip model face or fashionable pose. Heavy dark wet hair clings to face and shoulders, not salon waves. POWER: leaves water and brings fortune, benevolent presence only; the sea wave is ordinary physical surf, NOT a wave controlled by magic, no destructive attack or aura [c03]. SCALE & CAMERA: VERY LOW CLOSE camera near black basalt; FULL FIGURE from two big foreground goat hooves to head fills square. The two scaled legs, broad jagged translucent side fins, and distinctly cloven bare hooves must read instantly at 200 pixels. Hooves are NOT boots. Normal human size, large only by close perspective. LIGHT & WEATHER: DARK MOONLIT ATLANTIC NIGHT with one hard shaft of cold moonlight through storm-cloud gap striking wet scales, face, both fins and hoof splits; flying white surf against deep black-green water, strong contrast. NO visible moon disc, no sun disc, no orange sunset sky, no beach postcard. SURFACE: rough wet organic scales, thin jagged fin membranes with ribs, ridged bare goat horn hooves, salt-crusted woven top, coarse wet hair, rough black basalt. SETTING: rocky Atlantic sea shore as she emerges from water [c03]. MOOD: solemn compassionate supernatural awe, powerful daughter of sea, never evil or threatening, never pretty fashion portrait or mermaid costume. HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, letters, logo, border, frame, watermark; no extra heads, limbs or digits; no borrowed film/game/anime/comic designs; fully opaque top and body scales, no nudity or gore; no aura, neon, runes or energy ribbons. Square premium painterly cinematic brushwork.
name: Mulher marinha
rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.

rejected_attempts.reason: Keep the anatomy exactly: one adult woman in a fully opaque, high-necked, long-sleeved top; scaled from the waist down; two separate legs with fins along both; two cloven goat hooves (mulher-marinha-c01/c02). Keep her benevolent, with no menace, sexualised framing, nudity or fish tail. Fix: (a) Awe, not glamour. She rises out of the sea itself (c03/c05/c10) as a wave breaks behind and above her, with seawater pouring off her shoulders and legs and wet hair heavy with kelp and salt. Her face is grave and otherworldly, with a steady, direct gaze at the viewer, not a smooth made-up model face or a dreamy look. (b) Make the hybrid anatomy read at 200px. Use larger, ragged, translucent fins along the legs. Make the scales visibly her own body (irregular, wet and catching the light), not tights. Put the goat hooves large in the foreground on black basalt. (c) Light: a dark Atlantic storm gap or a moonlit sea, with one strong shaft of light on her and flying spray. No sun disc on the horizon and no golden-hour postcard. Use a low camera, with her filling the frame from hooves to head.

visual_review.notes: Native 1254px and 200px inspected: one grave adult sea woman, direct steady gaze, dark opaque high-neck long-sleeved top, two arms with five fingers each; waist-down organic raised scales, two separate legs, two large ragged translucent side fins, two clearly split cloven goat hooves. Both fins and hoof splits remain unmistakable at 200px, not tights or boots. Moonlit storm surf breaks behind her emergence c03; wet hair and pouring water, no glamour makeup or sunset. Open palm greeting conveys benevolent authority. No kelp asserted, invented magic, aura, text or borrowed design. All seven Sangar checks pass.

root_visual_review.notes: Viewed native 1254px, 200px, and face, both-hand, torso, leg/fin and hoof crops. This redraw answers the r03 reject. One adult woman (mulher-marinha-c01) with one head and two eyes. Her face is grave and weathered, with a furrowed brow, a closed mouth and a steady, direct gaze, and heavy wet dark hair clings to her shoulders. No makeup, smile or parted-lip glamour. Her dark sea-green top is high-necked, long-sleeved and fully opaque. Two arms: the raised open palm greeting the viewer and the hand steadying her on the basalt each have a thumb plus four fingers. From the waist down she is covered in irregular, overlapping, wet silver-green scales that read as her own body, not as leggings (c02). Two separate legs each carry a large, ragged, translucent, ribbed fin along the outer side (fins along her legs, c02). They end in two large cloven goat hooves, each clearly split into two horn halves (goat's feet, c01/c02). No fish tail. A big breaking wave towers behind her, and seawater pours off her arms and legs as she steps out of the sea onto black rock at night (she leaves the water, c03). The sky is storm cloud with a moonlit break, with no sun disc or sunset. The low camera gives a towering heroic view. Only her face and hands show skin and nothing is revealing, so the framing does not read as sexualised. No aura, magic, kelp, text or borrowed design. She is benevolent and grave, as section 6.5 asks: at 200px the towering, finned, hoofed daughter of the sea before the storm wave inspires awe, and does not read as a costume pose on a beach.
